title:
This epic is used to carry out verification of selected parsed sensors in Sensor Match Verification Grid,
when there are duplicate matches present in selected parsed sensors. Uses the below criteria to resolve conflicts

OPTION 1: Skip all duplicate matches: Only verifies non-duplicates selected items in the Sensor match grid.
OPTION 2: Confirm all new matches: Verifies all the selected items in Sensor match grid.
OPTION 3: Confirm selected new matches: Verifies the combination of non-duplicate matches in the sensor match grid and selected items in the duplicates grid.

Also, the epic accepts an array of dataSpecs of components which have to refreshed in the UI in the payload.
name: UiSdlEpicDuplicateVerification
